summary: Frontend-only verification of iter22: weekly digest toggle, book-digest preview button, inline date clear, and attention deep-links. Logged in as advisor@compass.ca with TOTP MFA (challenge+code flow), injected token into localStorage, and ran end-to-end UI + API checks on /tasks and /clients. All 4 new features PASS and digest settings were restored to {enabled:true, weekly_enabled:true, hour:8}.

test_results.weekly_digest_toggle: PASS — GET /advisor/digest-settings now returns {enabled, weekly_enabled, hour}. Toggling digest-weekly-toggle flipped weekly_enabled from true→false while enabled stayed true (independent). After re-toggling and reload, backend state persisted as {enabled:true, weekly_enabled:true, hour:8}. Shared digest-hour-select present.
test_results.book_digest_preview: PASS — Clicked [data-testid=weekly-preview-button]; no console errors, no exception. Button mutation fired (per code, calls POST /advisor/book-digest/preview and surfaces graceful info toast when sent:false in preview env, as pre-verified by main agent).
test_results.inline_date_clear: PASS — On open task task-due-4681d0df-… the inline clear button [data-testid=task-due-<id>-clear] appeared immediately after selecting a day in the calendar popover (without reopening it). Clicking it issued PATCH with empty due_date and the chip reverted to 'Set due date'.
test_results.attention_deep_link_valid: PASS — Navigating to /clients?open=client_a1 auto-opened the household and routed to /profile (page.url ended with /profile).
test_results.attention_deep_link_invalid: PASS — /clients?open=nonexistent_zzz stayed on /clients and displayed error toast 'That household link is no longer available' (captured in final screenshot).
test_results.regression_daily_preview: PASS — Daily digest-preview-button still clickable and triggers the preview mutation without errors.
test_results.regression_hour_select: PASS — Shared digest-hour-select is rendered and persisted hour=8 after reload.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Playwright page.is_visible('[data-testid=digest-enabled-toggle]') returned False even though clicks on these testids worked and state mutated correctly — the data-testid is likely on a nested span inside the Toggle wrapper. Not a bug, but adding data-testid on the outermost interactive wrapper of Toggle would make it more test-stable.
test_credentials: advisor@compass.ca / Compass2026! with TOTP secret JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP (login returns challenge, then POST /auth/mfa/verify with {challenge, code}).
seed_data_creation: None. Only toggled digest_settings during test; restored to {enabled:true, weekly_enabled:true, hour:8} as instructed. Set a due date on one task then cleared it via inline X — final state: that task has no due date.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MFA verify body must be {challenge, code} (not mfa_token). Login flow: POST /auth/login → {status:'mfa_required', challenge} → POST /auth/mfa/verify → {token, user}. Then set localStorage compass_token + compass_tier='advisor' and go. All iter22 features confirmed working via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
